item.title: Men lose their Y chromosome as they age. Scientists thought it didn’t matter — but now we’re learning more
item.description: Men lose the Y chromosome with age, previously thought insignificant, but now linked to diseases like cancer and Alzheimer's. New research suggests the Y chromosome plays a broader role in gene regulation, impacting health and lifespan.

item.title: East London is at high risk of extreme flooding — here’s how to limit the damage
item.description: East London faces severe flood risks due to urbanization and climate change. Natural solutions like green roofs and wetlands can mitigate these risks by slowing water runoff. Socioeconomic challenges exacerbate vulnerability, highlighting the need for integrated urban resilience strategies.

item.title: India’s freight emissions could rise 400% by 2047 without urgent reform: SFC–TERI report
item.description: India's freight emissions could rise by 400% by 2047 without policy reform, warns a report by SFC and TERI. It calls for a harmonised emissions accounting framework and India-specific emission factors to support decarbonisation and align with global standards.

item.title: Remembering T Madhava Menon (1929–2026): A life devoted to tribal justice, sustainable agriculture and humane governance
item.description: T Madhava Menon, a former IAS officer, passed away at 96, leaving a legacy in tribal justice, sustainable agriculture, and governance. His work in Kerala influenced national policies on tribal rights and land restoration, emphasizing community participation and cultural dignity.
